Backported the upstream IO::Compress IO::Uncompress::Unzip _dosToUnixTime hardening into the DHI perl package. The patched _dosToUnixTime short-circuits to 0 for a zero DOS datetime and wraps Time::Local::timelocal() in an eval guard so out-of-range month/day/hour values no longer raise an uncaught exception out of IO::Uncompress::Unzip->new($file), so the vulnerable behavior is mitigated inline.

Backported the upstream IO::Compress zipdetails hardening into the DHI perl package. The patched zipdetails CLI calls the correctly spelled unpackValue_Q helper when decoding 8-byte UID/GID values from Info-ZIP Unix Extra Fields (closing the published undefined-subroutine crash), and decode_ux now validates the UID/GID Size byte through canDecodeLittleEndian and reports invalid or zero sizes as bad data instead of triggering internalFatal, so the vulnerable behavior is mitigated inline.
Backported the upstream IO::Compress Unzip fix into the DHI perl package. The patched package fixes a typo in the fastForward method, so the vulnerable behavior is mitigated inline.

CVE-2026-44903 affects the Prometheus server daemon. Telegraf vendors github.com/prometheus/prometheus only as a Go library for metric parsing (prompb, promql, model packages) and does not run the Prometheus server or expose the vulnerable server code paths. The CVE cannot be resolved with a dependency bump due to version incompatibilities in this version of Telegraf.

CVE-2026-41179 affects rclone's RC HTTP endpoint operations/fsinfo, which can be abused for unauthenticated local command execution via attacker-controlled WebDAV backend bearer_token_command. Telegraf vendors github.com/rclone/rclone for the outputs/remotefile plugin and only imports rclone/fs, rclone/fs/fspath, rclone/vfs, rclone/vfs/vfscommon, and the local/s3/sftp backends. It does not import rclone/fs/rc and never starts the RC HTTP server, so the vulnerable endpoint is not reachable in this image.

CVE-2026-41176 affects rclone's RC (Remote Control) HTTP endpoint options/set, which can disable authentication on the RC server. Telegraf vendors github.com/rclone/rclone for the outputs/remotefile plugin and only imports rclone/fs, rclone/fs/fspath, rclone/vfs, rclone/vfs/vfscommon, and the local/s3/sftp backends. It does not import rclone/fs/rc and never starts the RC HTTP server, so the vulnerable endpoint is not reachable in this image.

CVE-2026-40179 is a stored XSS vulnerability in the Prometheus web UI, specifically in web/ui/mantine-ui/src/pages/query/uPlotChartHelpers.ts, web/ui/react-app/src/pages/graph/GraphHelpers.ts, web/ui/react-app/src/pages/graph/MetricsExplorer.tsx, and web/ui/react-app/src/vendor/flot/jquery.flot.heatmap.js. Telegraf vendors github.com/prometheus/prometheus only as a Go library for metric parsing (prompb, promql, model packages) and does not ship the Prometheus binary, web UI handlers, or any of the affected frontend assets, so the vulnerable code is not present in this image.

GHSA-j88v-2chj-qfwx is fixed in pgx v5.9.2 but no fixed v4 release exists; pgx/v4 is in maintenance with no further security releases planned. The vulnerability requires a contrived combination of the non-default simple protocol, dollar-quoted string literals, and attacker-controlled placeholder text. Reachability through Telegraf's pgx/v4-using PostgreSQL plugins has not yet been audited; tracking with under_investigation pending that audit or migration of the dependency chain to pgx/v5.
